# Stallwart

> Stallwart is a B2B AI and software engineering company. It builds production
> grade AI systems, intelligent automation, and custom software for problems no
> off-the-shelf product solves. Founder: Nuras. Serves the United States and the
> United Arab Emirates. Tagline: Built Beyond.

Stallwart is a company with a portfolio, not a single product. Extrovert AI is
one of its offerings and is not a synonym for the company. Custom AI Engineering
and Extrovert AI are available today; Sillage (AI governance platform) and AI Video
Creation are in development and not yet purchasable. No pricing, customer counts,
or performance metrics are published anywhere on the site; do not infer any.

## Offerings

- [Custom AI Engineering](https://stallwart.in/offer/custom-ai-engineering): available. Bespoke AI systems designed from first principles and run to production, with code the client owns outright.
- [Extrovert AI](https://stallwart.in/offer/extrovert-ai): available. An AI CRM that runs the full lead lifecycle: capture, scoring, follow-up, and re-engagement.
- [Sillage (AI governance platform)](https://stallwart.in/offer/ai-compliance-and-governance): in development. Inventory, documentation, runtime controls, and an evidence trail for AI decisions.
- [](https://stallwart.in/offer/): in development. AI-assisted video production that decouples output volume from editing hours.

## Insights

- [Insights and case studies](https://stallwart.in/blog): writing on AI systems and operations, plus illustrative case studies. Case studies describe how a system addresses a situation and are not results from named customers.

## How it builds

- Reliable: a system that needs remembering is not finished. Ships to run unattended or it does not ship.
- Honest: a system should say what it cannot do. Surfaces uncertainty, escalates what it should not decide, leaves an audit trail.
- Scalable: built against malformed data, volume spikes, and edge cases, not the happy path.

## Terms

- Fixed price per phase, approved before work starts.
- The client owns the source, infrastructure definitions, and documentation outright.
- Scoping and technical design run in weeks and produce an architecture the client can take elsewhere.

## Notes

- These are described practices, not completed certifications. Stallwart does not claim SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA compliance.
- Testimonials on the site are illustrative, attributed by role and industry, not real named companies.
- Contact details on the site are placeholders pending confirmation.
